probes.note: this harness's OWN bash tool is itself nono-confined and already denies ~/.ssh before the inner worktree-agent profile is even applied — not a clean Landlock-specific differential on this host, so the inner profile's own explicit deny entry (also present) is the attribution that holds

probes.expectation: non-zero exit (denied by DAC mode 640 root:shadow independent of Landlock)
probes.note: redundant-with-dac: this uid cannot read /etc/shadow with or without Landlock

probes.evidence: status=2 out=/usr/bin/sh: 1: cannot create /etc/slaat-p1-4-probe: Permission denied

probes.description: confined read through a symlink (inside allowed dir) pointing at $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa
probes.expectation: non-zero exit — Landlock resolves the real target, not the link path

probes.description: confined read through a symlink pointing at /etc/passwd
probes.expectation: exit 0 — /etc/passwd is granted by nono's composed 'system_read_linux_core' baseline group (NSS dependency), not by worktree-agent.json's own explicit read list
probes.note: corrected expectation: an earlier draft of this probe wrongly assumed the profile denies anything it does not explicitly list; nono composes a baseline system-read capability group (glibc NSS paths) into every profile regardless, which this symlink read correctly traverses to — not a leak introduced by worktree-agent.json
boundary is Landlock filesystem scoping (no /proc grant) rather than a /proc-specific LSM rule

probes.description: confined process can inspect its OWN /proc/self (expected, not an escape)
probes.expectation: exit 0 — self-introspection is not a boundary violation
probes.note: control: distinguishes 'denied /proc entirely' from 'denied OTHER pids under /proc'

probes.description: confined ptrace-attach to an unrelated sibling process (host yama ptrace_scope=0)
probes.evidence: scope=0 status=1 out=strace: attach: ptrace(PTRACE_SEIZE, 130967): Operation not permitted
probes.note: attribution corrected from an earlier draft: ptrace_scope=0 means Yama is NOT restricting this (scope 0 is unrestricted same-uid ptrace), so the observed EPERM is nono's own seccomp-bpf denial of ptrace(2), not Landlock and not Yama — a containment layer this probe found in place but attributed to the wrong mechanism on first pass

probes.expectation: non-zero exit, Operation not permitted (missing CAP_NET_RAW)
probes.evidence:
status=1 out=Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
    import socket; socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_RAW, 1)
                   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
probes.note: redundant-with-capability: this uid lacks CAP_NET_RAW with or without Landlock/nono

probes.evidence:
status=1 out=/usr/bin/bash: connect: Permission denied
/usr/bin/bash: line 1: /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/39999: Permission denied

probes.expectation: informational — namespace creation is a capability/sysctl question, not Landlock's
probes.evidence: status=1 allowed=0 out=unshare: unshare failed: Operation not permitted
probes.note: informational probe; see ns.unshare-does-not-widen-fs-access for the security-relevant half

probes.description: a process that unshares into a NEW pid namespace still cannot read $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa
probes.expectation: non-zero exit — Landlock's ruleset is inherited across unshare(CLONE_NEWPID), not reset
probes.evidence: status=1 out=unshare: unshare failed: Operation not permitted
probes.note: the critical escape this probe rules out: unshare as a Landlock-bypass vector

probes.description: a child process spawned by a confined shell is itself confined
probes.expectation: non-zero exit — Landlock rulesets are inherited by children (PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS-equivalent persistence)

probes.description: a background subshell started inside the confined process attempts the same denied read
probes.expectation: the denied file is never written to the exfil path — no race window

probes.description: confined write+read inside the allow-listed worktree path
probes.note: positive control: without this, a broken/non-functional sandbox would also 'pass' every denial above
